Reshii is a form of mystical energy associated with ancient K'areshi civilization and their transmutation into the energy beings known as ethereals. While its exact properties are never fully described, Reshii is present in the environment and living organisms. Artifacts such as Reshii Ribbons and the Reshii Wraps are capable of transmuting Reshii into arcane energy and channeling it. Before the Devouring, Xal'atath taught the Naakroan to steal it from the land, animals, and their own kin, and later guided Locus-Walker and the Ravel to use their Reshii Ribbons to shield the world against Dimensius and eventually transform themselves into ethereals.

The Research Console is a machine located at the Howling Ridge in the Voidstorm. After it has been unlocked during Researching the Storm, the console can be used to perform Void Research to gain various bonuses while in the Voidstorm. Researching the final upgrade grants the Staring Into The Void achievement and the Lab-grown Stormray mount.

Resist Fire is a world buff that can be applied to player's by using Mind Control (either by the Priest spell or the Engineering device) on a Scarshield Spellbinder in Blackrock Spire and using the spell on players. The Reshii Wraps ( ) are an cloak obtained from The Tabiqa as part of the Ghosts of K'aresh campaign added in patch 11.2.0. The cloak is required for the Manaforge Omega raid, as well as various open-world tasks in K'aresh like Phase Diving. It starts at Hero 1 (ilvl 694) and can be upgraded all the way to the equivalent of Myth 8 (ilvl 730). Alts of characters who have completed That's a Wrap and The Untethered Horror for Phase Diving can check in with Om'en after landing in Tazavesh and tell him to skip the questline. This will not immediately award the wraps, but players can head directly to Hashim at on Overlook Zo'Shuul, where they can pick up the wraps by telling him . Fully upgrading
